name: The Alliance Needs More Medium Leather!
label: Quest
description: The Alliance Needs More Medium Leather!: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Yes friend, looks like we've collected many pieces of medium leather, but we need more. I can assure you that it will all be put to good use; not one piece will get wasted. I know it's a lot to ask, but if you're still willing, I could use your help in attempting to put a dent in the rest of my quota.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Golly, that sure is a lot of medium leather that you've brought round, friend! I'm gonna make sure that all of that gets put to proper use, yes indeed. With your help we'll have filled our estimation for medium leather in no time!
